parameters.name: ExecutionStatus
parameters.description: The execution status. This parameter is applicable to CompleteExecution.

parameters.name: LoopItem
parameters.description: The item data corresponding to the loop child node.

parameters.name: NotifyNote
parameters.description: The notification message for description purposes.

parameters.name: NotifyType
parameters.description:
The notification type. Valid values:
- **ExecuteTask**: starts a specified task execution. This value is applicable to Debug mode. You may need to specify the Parameters parameter.
- **CancelTask**: cancels the current task execution. This value is applicable to Debug mode.
- **CompleteExecution**: manually terminates an execution in Debug mode. You can use the **ExecutionStatus** parameter to specify the status of the terminated execution.
- **Approve**: approves a pending execution. For example, you are aware of the risks of a high-risk operation task execution and approve the execution.
- **Reject**: rejects a pending execution. For example, you do not approve a high-risk operation task execution.
- **RetryTask**: retries a failed task execution. This value is applicable to the failure-pause mode.
- **SkipTask**: skips a failed task execution. This value is applicable to the failure-pause mode.

parameters.name: Parameters
parameters.description: The parameters. This parameter is applicable to ExecuteTask.

parameters.name: TaskExecutionIds
parameters.description: The list of task execution IDs.

parameters.name: TaskName
parameters.description: The name of the next task to execute.
